# Eastern and Western Christian Traditions Claim Audit

Support the primary activity for T5-L07 - Eastern and Western Christian Traditions.

## Use
- Lesson: T5-L07 - Eastern and Western Christian Traditions
- Big idea: Cultural, political, linguistic, and theological differences contributed to enduring institutional division.
- Primary reading: John 17:20-23; selected historical evidence

## Evidence moves
1. Record direct observations.
2. Mark interpretation or canonical synthesis separately.
3. For historical claims, record the external source and confidence level.
4. State one faithful response without upgrading inference into explicit text.

## Publication hold
Do not publish post-biblical historical claims until the relevant primary/local source packet has been verified and cited.
